Pairs of input strings together with the longest common subsequence the algorithm should return for them. This data set is shared by the tests that exercise the subsequence-returning methods ({@link LongestCommonSubsequence#longestCommonSubsequence} and its deprecated {@code logestCommonSubsequence} alias). @return arguments of {@code (left, right, expectedSubsequence)}.
Pairs of input strings together with the length of their longest common subsequence, as returned by {@link LongestCommonSubsequence#apply}. @return arguments of {@code (left, right, expectedLength)}.
